rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for riding a horse, bicycle, or something ridden astride such as a broomstick.

example.english: I like to ride my bicycle to work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 kei4 daan1 ce1 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when you mean taking or travelling by a vehicle as a passenger, especially public transport.

example.english: We ride the bus to school every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat6 jat6 daap3 ce1 faan1 hok6

rows.note: Use this when focusing on being seated or transported in a vehicle rather than on the act of taking the transport.

example.english: Don't fall asleep when you ride in the car.
example.jyutping: co5 ce1 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 fan3 zoek6

rows.note: Use 車程 as the all-purpose noun for a ride understood as a vehicle journey or trip.

example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 ce1 cing4 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use 車 for the vehicle itself when ride means a car or other vehicle in casual speech.

example.jyutping: nei5 gaa3 ce1 gei2 leng3 wo3

rows.note: Use 順風車 for a lift from someone who is travelling in the same direction, especially a free ride.

example.english: Thanks for giving me a ride home.
example.traditional: 多謝你畀我搭順風車返屋企。
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 bei2 ngo5 daap3 seon6 fung1 ce1 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use 機動遊戲 for rides at an amusement park or fair rather than for ordinary transport.

example.english: This ride spins me so much that I get dizzy.
example.traditional: 呢個機動遊戲轉到我頭都暈。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gei1 dung6 jau4 hei3 zyun2 dou3 ngo5 tau4 dou1 wan4

rows.note: Use this for repeatedly nagging or scolding someone, rather than for merely annoying them once.

example.english: Don't ride me all the time!
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ngo4 ngo5 laa1
